summary: Upgrade @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk from 0.3.260 to 0.3.296 (bundled Claude Code CLI 2.1.260 to 2.1.296). No adapter code change was needed: the release notes between the two versions change nothing that claude-adapter.ts relies on for canUseTool, effort, streaming input, mcpServers, resume or rate_limit_event.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app does not depend on the Claude Agent SDK. It reaches Claude sessions only through the backend's provider events, whose shapes this upgrade does not change.

nativeAndroid.reason: The native Android app does not depend on the Claude Agent SDK. It reaches Claude sessions only through the backend's provider events, whose shapes this upgrade does not change.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema or stored-data change. Claude transcripts stay in the CLI's own JSONL format, and resume of a session written by the 2.1.260 CLI was not changed by the release notes.

hardware: Live SDK smoke with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-tech-team on macOS arm64, outside the app: a streaming-input query with model haiku, effort low and permissionMode default; canUseTool received the Write call (with the new defaultToNo and suppressAlwaysAllowRule option fields) and its deny reached the model; rate_limit_event arrived with the same rate_limit_info fields the adapter reads; a second query with resume answered from the first session's context.
notExercised: No desktop app session ran on 0.3.296; the smoke drove the SDK directly with the adapter's option shape.
The Switchboard MCP server (mcpServers stdio) was not started in the live smoke; it is covered by the mocked adapter tests only.
Remote machines pick up 0.3.296 at their next provision (provision-deps.ts reads the version from package.json); no remote was provisioned.
